composing_text: Cruiser Division 6 joined the newly formed Eighth Fleet on 14 July 1942 (記事, PDF p. 8).
current_activity: Eighth Fleet headquarters at Rabaul; flagship Chokai ordered from Kavieng to Rabaul at 0549
notes: JACAR 8th Fleet wartime log, C08030022500. The late-July 經過 records Chokai’s arrival at Rabaul and the transfer of the flag to a shore building; the 7 August entry places the CinC’s operations in the Rabaul–Kavieng area (Chokai at Kavieng at dawn, ordered to Rabaul). The headquarters is therefore claimed at Rabaul on 7 August. Confidence 0.5: a single official family (jacar). No Kavieng harbour place is in the gazetteer, so the dawn position of Chokai at Kavieng is not entered as a separate pin. Operation is OP-FRONT-PACIFIC (southwest_pacific); OP-CAMP-GUADALCANAL is south_pacific and cannot be used for a Rabaul claim. current_activity was shortened so it stays within the 120-character warning. The previous text was: 'Eighth Fleet headquarters at Rabaul; CinC flagship Chokai ordered from Kavieng to Rabaul at 0549, with Tenryu, Yubari and Yunagi to sortie at 1600'. The shortened text is: 'Eighth Fleet headquarters at Rabaul; flagship Chokai ordered from Kavieng to Rabaul at 0549'. The 1600 sortie of Tenryu, Yubari and Yunagi is retained in this note, not dropped from the record. Branch air-naval-friction-fixes, 26 November 2026.
